name: New Ireland Coastal Undercurrent
scope: Declared regional east-coast New Ireland reach from an OSW southeastern offshore gate near 153.6 E, 4.5 S to an OSW northern offshore gate near 150.9 E, 2.2 S. Excludes Solomon Strait inflow across the basin, New Britain and St Georges branches, Bismarck Sea westward continuation, retroflection and downstream EUC route. Gates are editorial truncations, not whole-current origin or termination.
layer: Subsurface thermocline boundary-current geography. Grenier et al. discuss density-dependent modeled pathways; no single fixed-depth axis or whole-depth current footprint extracted for this coastal reach.
time_convention: Editorial geographic reach informed by source background and ORCA025-G70 modeled pathways. The simulation covers 1958–2004, while analysis excludes the 2002 forcing adjustment and ends in 2001. These dates are study context, not exact observations, a measured annual mean axis or seasonal route.
source_locator: Grenier et al. (2011), Introduction [5] and Figure 1 caption: NICU along eastern New Ireland and separate NGCU/SICU; section 2.1 [12]–[15]: 0.25-degree model and gateway limitations; section 3.2 [22] and coastal pathway discussion. Relevant text read; no source axis digitized.
source_citation: Grenier et al. (2011), From the western boundary currents to the Pacific Equatorial Undercurrent: Modeled pathways and water mass evolutions, Journal of Geophysical Research: Oceans 116, doi:10.1029/2011JC007477.
source_license: Publisher labels Free Access; no explicit open reuse license inspected. Attributed regional facts paraphrased; no source figure, model field or particle track packaged.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects coarse offshore vertices along eastern New Ireland from a southeastern approach to a northern approach. Source descriptions establish regional orientation, not supplied coordinates. The gate sequence excludes downstream branching, retroflection and Solomon Strait sections. Coarse land avoidance does not verify narrow channels or the subsurface current axis. An initial closer-island scenario touched the coarse land mask near the central island; intermediate vertices were moved 0.2 degree east and all scenarios regenerated. Fine bathymetric review remains pending.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW coarse lateral alternative, not an observed axis or current edge.

scenario_rule: Three declared regional shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degrees: 81 editorial scenarios. Not current width, seasonal extent or a confidence interval.
remaining_gates: Review finer island coastline and bathymetry before claiming a subsurface coastal axis.
